name: Offer change-approval gate (executing → awaiting_approval)
description: First human gate. When a run's generated OpenSpec change has been authored and blessed by the CLI validator (openspec.validated present) but no human approval exists yet (run.change_approved absent), move the run to awaiting_approval so the dev loop cannot start. This encodes the validate-before-approval ordering (G-io task 4.4/3.7): approval is only offered after the change is OpenSpec-valid. The transition is rule-owned (G2) — no product Go fires it. CONTRACT (design D15): this rule evaluates conditions against the RUN entity, so group 4's validate harness MUST stamp openspec.validated on the run entity (subject = agent.run.entity_id), not on the loop or a change entity, or this rule never fires and the run wedges silently.

on_enter.reason: change authored and OpenSpec-validated; awaiting human change approval
